apis.name: Bing News Search API
apis.why_notable: Microsoft's news search API with category, trending, and market filters; widely used enterprise alternative to NewsAPI.

apis.name: News API AI
apis.why_notable: Event Registry's developer-facing product for semantic news search, event clustering, and concept extraction.

apis.name: LSEG News API (formerly Refinitiv)
apis.why_notable: Professional financial/news wire access for market-moving journalism and corporate news.

apis.name: Associated Press API
apis.why_notable: Wire-service content API from AP for headlines, photos, and full stories under licensed access.

apis.name: AFP API
apis.why_notable: Agence France-Presse content API for international wire news and multimedia.

apis.name: NewsWhip API
apis.why_notable: Predicts and ranks breaking stories by social velocity across publishers.

apis.name: Aylien News API
apis.why_notable: NLP-enriched news search with entities, sentiment, and story clustering (now part of Meltwater).

apis.name: Diffbot News API
apis.why_notable: Structured article extraction from any URL plus Knowledge Graph news search.

apis.name: SerpApi Google News
apis.why_notable: Scrapes Google News results into JSON with engine-compatible params and pagination.
